summary: Korn Ferry filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a Sale and Purchase Agreement to acquire all shares of Auxey Holdco Limited (AMS) for ~£850 million (~$1.1 billion) through ~£659M cash and ~£191M in stock. The stock component is subject to a collar (85%-115% of $71.3815 VWAP). The deal uses a locked-box mechanism with a December 31, 2025 locked-box date and standard leakage protections. The filing does not name a board recommendation or advisor. Closing awaits regulatory and customary conditions; watch for regulatory clearance timing and collar mechanics that could shift the stock portion's value.
